clipboard_v1.capture: Synchronous owned opaque bytes + complete existing 8-field Stamp. Requires coherent idle writable unlocked complete selection/subtree; no canonical change, operation or History.
clipboard_v1.format: AXCB version 1 envelope containing canonical InsertObjects operation bytes and optional resource descriptor operation bytes. These are data, never replayed as source operations. Unsupported version/kind/oversize/malformed/dangling data reject. Max 16 MiB, 4096 object records.
clipboard_v1.closure: Selected roots plus all structural descendants. Copy root transforms in world space; preserve child local transforms and order. Internal connector attachments remap, external attachments detach at resolved endpoint.
clipboard_v1.identity: Runtime allocates fresh object, text paragraph, Table row/column and erase-mask IDs; preserves style seeds, content/resources and descendants.
clipboard_v1.placement: Paste offsets world-space roots by requested finite offset (default 24,24); current group scope is destination parent with inverse conversion. Duplicate preserves selected roots parents and applies same world offset. New roots are selected in point mode.
clipboard_v1.cut: Capture/write OS clipboard first, then cut with captured complete stamp. Any stale/foreign stamp rejects zero-mutation; queued Duplicate/Paste also capture and validate the complete basis. Cut uses canonical delete closure including dependent connectors; History restores full closure. Section Cut removes its subtree (Delete key retains existing release-boundary semantics).
clipboard_v1.resources: Opaque bundle includes exact referenced resource descriptors including fallback closure; target must already have matching active resources through existing external resource owner. No silent substitution or partial paste; no new blob storage/network owner. Same-runtime image/font/brush references remain available.
clipboard_v1.platform: Root JS copySelection/cutSelection/duplicateSelection/pasteObjects, matching declarations and shared Session/Windows caller wrapper. Existing C/POD JSON transport ABI, no C++ internals exposed.
clipboard_v1.keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+C/D/X/V on canvas outside native text, HTML editable controls, IME and dialogs. Copy/Cut write typed + prefixed plain clipboard data; Paste accepts that versioned format. Clipboard write failure never deletes source.
clipboard_v1.paint_order: Capture current root paint order in detached placement keys before canonical ObjectId sorting; preserve relative stacking on duplicate/paste and all child order keys.
